### Install
- **On your phone:** download **`AnamorphicDesqueeze-vX.Y.apk`** below and open it. Allow **Install unknown apps** when asked; if Play Protect warns about an unknown developer, tap **Install anyway**.
- **Updating:** from v1.7 on, new versions install straight over the old one. Coming from v1.6 or older? Uninstall it once first.
- The **`-play.aab`** file is for publishing on Google Play; it can't be installed directly.

Requires Android 10 or newer. Signing certificate SHA-256: `38:C0:B0:B2:C3:60:04:A3:90:49:A1:BD:11:7B:B0:04:2F:8C:04:54:1D:5B:F1:6A:DE:0F:59:B4:0E:1D:A4:5E` ([how to verify](https://github.com/jemishmayani/Anamorphic-Desqueeze/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-download)).
